## Log and diagnostic files

Attach or paste the relevant part of `metcalf_output/metcalf-YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS.log`.
If `*_shifts.csv` was created, attach it as well. A small sample FITS or preview is helpful when you can share it.

Do **not** attach `.astrometry_api_key`, private observing-site details that you do not wish to share, or unrelated personal files.
